description: CUTLASS-style tiled FP32 GEMM using a custom kernel with shared-memory staging and register tiling. Block tile BM×BN=64×64, K-tile BK=8, thread tile TM×TN=8×8, 64 threads/block. Self-contained, no external library. Reports GFLOPS.

scaling_param.name: matrix_dim
scaling_param.description: Square matrix dimension M=N=K; must be a multiple of 64 (block tile size)

non_scaling_params.name: block_tile_m
non_scaling_params.description: Block tile size in M dimension
